contracts.name: T08-01 authenticated create / checkpoints / assembly / export (simulated boundaries)
T08-02 unauthenticated create and export reject before side effects
T08-03 exhausted quota blocks generation
T08-04 hybrid without approval must release its reservation
T08-05 failed video INSERT must release its reservation
T08-06 missing worker claim must not execute generation
T08-07 concurrent duplicate creation with same Idempotency-Key generates once
T08-08 interrupted scene preserves checkpoint and recovery only regenerates missing visual
T08-09 checkpoint rejection stops assembly and provider failure releases quota
T08-10 create response must redact provider credential-shaped errors
T08-11 export IDOR rejects foreign video before render
T08-12 export rejects a version attached to another video
T08-13 export DB UPDATE failure must not return success
T08-14 export version INSERT failure must not return success
T08-15 concurrent exports allocate distinct durable version numbers
T08-16 approval consumption is one-shot under 8 concurrent callers
T08-17 approval DB outage prevents generation authorization
T08-18 expired or altered approval cannot authorize generation
T08-19 validate / schedule / publish two platforms through real handlers
T08-20 invalid schedule is rejected without DB write
T08-21 account ownership configuration cannot be forged by PATCH
T08-22 foreign approval and publication produce zero mutations
T08-23 approval must not overwrite a worker transition after its read
T08-24 bounded load: 8 workers / 32 videos / 64 simulated publications
T08-25 partial publication and retry retain successful platforms
T08-26 claim DB failure has zero publication effects
T08-27 finish RPC failure must not report confirmed provider success
T08-28 publication video-read DB outage must not become permanent content failure
T08-39 authenticated text/plain cross-origin creation must reject before effects
T08-29 cron rejects 64 forged credentials and permits exact synthetic credential
T08-30 media download must reject private / metadata / loopback addresses before fetch
T08-31 aborted media download makes zero requests and leaves no file
T08-32 observability emits one correlation id from start to finish
T08-33 cron terminal result must not be overwritten by a second finish
T08-34 observability log must redact credential-shaped errors
T08-35 stale reconciliation preserves current and completed runs
T08-36 schedule DST autumn overlap emits at most one occurrence per local day
T08-37 network guard rejects remote egress without contacting provider
T08-38 environment-file guard denies reads before filesystem access
T08-40 observability must not indefinitely block work on a hung DB transport
